_note: Reviewed corrections to the player master (scripts/build_player_master.py). Keyed by cricsheet_id; every field here wins over every other source. Retirements live in data/curated/ipl_availability.json. Fields: display_name, full_name, aliases (added to the searchable list), primary_role (batter|bowler|allrounder|wk_batter), bowling_style (right-arm-fast|right-arm-fast-medium|right-arm-medium|left-arm-fast|left-arm-medium|off-spin|leg-spin|left-arm-orthodox|left-arm-wrist-spin), batting_hand (left|right), country (ISO alpha-3, or ENG/SCO/WIN), team (IPL franchise code or null), dob (YYYY-MM-DD). Give every entry a `_name` and an `_evidence` (a source a reviewer can check). Disagreements still to settle are listed in data/curated/player_master_review.json.
